 Order
This Crl. M.C. has been filed seeking for a direction to the 3rd respondent to issue Police Clearance Certificate to the petitioner for securing a job in Malta.
2. The petitioner is the 1st accused in C.C. No. 106/2022 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ambalappuzha.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ambalappuzha
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable under Sections 498A and 323 r/w 34 of the IPC.
3. As per Annexure A4 order, personal appearance of the petitioner before the learned Magistrate has already been dispensed with.
Now the petitioner has to go abroad to get a job.
He filed an application before the 3rd respondent to issue the Police Clearance Certificate, which has not been disposed of till date.
It is in the said circumstances that this Crl.M.C. is filed.
4. I have heard Sri. Rahul Sasi, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, Smt. V. Sreeja, the learned Public Prosecutor and Sri. S. Manu, the learned DSGI.
CRL.MC NO. 3087 OF 2023 5.

When an application for Police Clearance Certificate is moved, the same has to be disposed of,
after conducting an enquiry as to the criminal antecedents of the accused.
As stated earlier, the petitioner is on bail and his personal appearance before the learned Magistrate has already been dispensed with.

6. Having heard both sides, this Crl. M.C. is disposed of with a direction to the 3rd respondent to consider Annexure A3 application and dispose of the same, in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, within a period of two weeks from the date of production of a copy of this order.
This Crl. M.C. is disposed of.

Sd/-
